flows.representativeInput: Fresh git fixture with no .ignore; archive.mjs ignore --check, --apply, --apply, --check
flows.expected: --check prints missing; --apply creates .ignore with docs/archive/ once; a second --apply leaves the file byte-identical

observations.actual: Test [AC:spec-6-1] passed (5/5 tests in the file passed): check -> {file:.ignore,line:docs/archive/,status:missing}, no file created; apply -> added, file is exactly "docs/archive/\n"; second apply -> present and Buffer.equals true. Reviewer probes also ran the CLI directly: no-trailing-newline line counts as present; decline then apply adds the line; bad or combined flags exit 1 with usage.

flows.representativeInput: Fixture joycraft.yaml with paths.archive: work/old and an existing .ignore "node_modules/" (no trailing newline)
flows.expected: --check reports work/old/ missing; --apply appends work/old/ on its own line

observations.actual: Test [AC:spec-6-2] passed: check -> line work/old/ missing; after apply .ignore is "node_modules/\nwork/old/\n". Reviewer probe: paths.archive "work/old/" (trailing slash) writes work/old/ once; ../evil and absolute archive paths are refused by workPaths with exit 1.

flows.representativeInput: payload/.joycraft/references/setup.md and update.md text; payload word count
flows.expected: Each file names archive.mjs ignore and asks the question once in one or two sentences, running --apply on a yes; payload words stay within the cap

observations.actual: Test [AC:spec-6-3] passed: each file matches /archive\.mjs ignore/ exactly once; [review-b-8] also checks each names --check ... missing and --decline. Source read: setup.md:307 and update.md:35-37 are one sentence each (ask once when --check prints missing; --apply on a yes, --decline on a no).
payload-guard word tests passed (2 passed, 12 skipped by -t filter); printed "payload words: 29834", below the field-24 cap and below 29,917.

findings.summary: archiveIgnore --apply follows a symlinked .ignore and appends to its target, even outside the project (probe: .ignore -> ../target got docs/archive/ appended). readPreferences refuses symlinks for preferences.json; .ignore has no such check.
findings.assumption: The spec does not decide symlinked .ignore files; rare case, so not blocking.

findings.summary: An existing "docs/archive/*" line is not counted as present, so --check says missing and --apply adds a second, equivalent line. Only trailing "/**", leading "./" or "/" and trailing slashes are normalized.
findings.assumption: Equivalent-spelling coverage beyond the tested set is not a stated criterion.

findings.summary: ignore uses process.cwd() as the project root; run from a subdirectory it reads that folder (no joycraft.yaml) and --apply would write .ignore there. The setup and update references run it from the root, so this is a usage limit.
findings.assumption: Commands are run from the project root, as the references show.

findings.summary: The repo's installed .joycraft/runtime/archive.mjs differs from payload/ (it has no ignore subcommand). AGENTS.md names payload/ as the source and gives no refresh step, so this is left to the release flow.
findings.assumption: Installed copies refresh on the next install/update, not in this spec.
